summary: Complaints centre on waterlogging on the roads, markets and CHC front of Shikarpur town after light rain, long power cuts and a dilapidated Khurja-Shikarpur road, with the CHC medicine issue an unconfirmed allegation; the main appreciation is a started Anupshahr-Shikarpur road widening, while most town works are still tendered or sanctioned rather than delivered.

round2.changes: (1) Opened and checked all 13 cited article URLs plus the identity page; all opened and supported their claims, so no source was removed. (2) Positives: #2 (SDM compensation claim) changed to inference because it is an official claim with no farmer confirmation; reordered positives by likely impact (started road, town roads and drains money, pipelines, compensation, handpumps). (3) Negative #1: removed the Girls Inter College claim (photo caption only) and the Syana-based EO attribution; rewrote Hindi to 13 words. (4) Negative #2: removed unverified 'fixed overnight' claim. (5) Negative #3: removed the prescription claim not in the article; Hindi shortened to 12 words. (6) Negative #4 and #5: basis corrected for dates, district-level sourcing and village/AC caveats. (7) Notes: removed the unverified MLA details and the unverified 2011 population figure. (8) Searched Hindi and English for delivered Shikarpur works 2024-2026; found none verifiable (a Statesman report of inaugurated Shikarpur projects returned HTTP 403, so it is not cited).

positives.english: Widening work on the Anupshahr road has started
positives.hindi: अनूपशहर वाली सड़क का चौड़ीकरण शुरू हो गया है
positives.basis: Amar Ujala (12 May 2025), opened and checked: widening of the Anupshahr-Shikarpur road has begun; cost Rs 31.28 crore; work started after the first instalment of over Rs 10 crore. The article says the road connects Shikarpur and Khurja; it does not name the stretch or give a completion date. Route-level, so AC membership of the stretch is not confirmed.

positives.english: *2.90 crore is to be spent on town roads, drains and culverts
positives.hindi: *सड़कों, नालियों और पुलियों पर 2.90 करोड़ खर्च होंगे
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (30 Sep 2026), opened and checked: Shikarpur Nagar Palika Parishad will spend Rs 2.90 crore on 20 works, mainly roads, drains and culverts, funded from the 15th Finance Commission, State Finance Commission and municipal funds. No start or completion date is given, so this is planned spending, not delivered work.

positives.english: *Water pipelines are to be laid in Muftiwara and Kotsher Khan
positives.hindi: *मुफ्तीवाड़ा और कोटशेर खां में पानी की पाइपलाइन बिछने वाली है
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026), opened and checked: tenders are complete for about Rs 1.22 crore of works, including 783 m of pipeline in Muftiwara (ward 4, Rs 16.48 lakh) and 1,490 m in Kotsher Khan (ward 19, Rs 15.07 lakh). The works are planned; no start date and no completion are reported.

positives.english: *I hear compensation reaches accounts within seven days of the deed
positives.hindi: *सुना है बैनामे के सात दिन में मुआवजा खाते में आ जाता है
positives.basis: Inference: ETV Bharat (2 Jul 2026), opened and checked: SDM Ravindra Pratap Singh says payment is sent to farmers' accounts within 7 days of the official sale deed; 62 deeds are done so far, and about 6 km of the Bulandshahr-Jewar expressway route is affected in Shikarpur tehsil. This is an official claim. The article has no farmer confirmation and gives no amount, so delivery is not verified.

positives.english: *Fifteen handpumps in town are to be repaired
positives.hindi: *शहर के 15 हैंडपंप ठीक कराए जाने हैं
positives.basis: Inference: Amar Ujala (3 Oct 2026), opened and checked: re-boring of 15 India Mark handpumps is among the Rs 1.22 crore Nagar Palika works, and the article says tenders for all works are complete. Repair is planned; the article does not report it as done.

negatives.english: Light rain floods our roads, the market and the front of the CHC
negatives.hindi: हल्की बारिश में सड़कों, बाज़ार और सीएचसी के सामने पानी भर जाता है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (23 Aug 2026), opened and checked: Balaji Market and the Kotwali turn in Shikarpur town are waterlogged; residents blame garbage in a culvert and drains not cleaned on time; EO Neetu Singh says drains have been cleaned and problem spots will be inspected. Royal Bulletin (23 Aug 2026): water on the main roads and crossings of Shikarpur Nagar after light rain. Dynamite News (9 May 2026): waterlogging in front of the CHC and block office in the Nagar Palika area. Amar Ujala video (7 Jul 2026): the same spot on the Khurja-Shikarpur road in front of the CHC and block office. The Syana part of the 23 Aug article is excluded because Syana is not confirmed inside this AC. The Girls Inter College spot appears only in a photo caption, so it is not used.

negatives.english: Power was off for 36 hours in Shikarpur even after a new cable was laid
negatives.hindi: नया केबल डालने के बाद भी शिकारपुर में 36 घंटे बिजली गुल रही
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (30 Jun 2026), opened and checked: the outage in Shikarpur continued for 36 hours even after a new cable was laid. A storm and rain caused breakdowns on the Mangraul and Chitsaun feeders, which the article links to more than 10 villages; the Executive Engineer says a 33 KVA line broke down in the storm. Feeder village membership is not confirmed. The article's Dibai and other areas are not part of this item.

negatives.english: It is alleged that patients are told to buy medicines from outside the CHC
negatives.hindi: आरोप है, सीएचसी में दवा बाहर से लेने को कहा जाता है
negatives.basis: Knews (10 Sep 2026), opened and checked: allegations that poor and labour patients at Shikarpur CHC are told to buy medicines from private medical stores, and a local allegation of a commission racket between the CHC in-charge and some doctors. The article says these allegations are not independently confirmed. CMO Dr Sunil Kumar Dohri says all necessary medicines are available in hospitals. Allegation only, not verified.

negatives.english: Stray cattle wreck our crops and sugarcane dues are still pending
negatives.hindi: आवारा पशु फसल उजाड़ते हैं और गन्ने का बकाया पड़ा है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (14 Jul 2025), opened and checked: BKU farmers' padyatra from Jakhaita village to Shikarpur tehsil listed crop damage by stray cattle, low electricity, damaged roads, unpaid sugarcane dues and fake fertiliser and seed; a memorandum went to the SDM and CO and no official response is reported. Jakhaita's tehsil membership is not confirmed. ETV Bharat (4 Apr 2026, district-level BKU demands) repeats the stray-animal and sugarcane-dues demands. No 2026 Shikarpur-specific update found.

negatives.english: The Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years
negatives.hindi: खुर्जा-शिकारपुर सड़क 15 साल से जर्जर है
negatives.basis: Amar Ujala (20 Dec 2024), opened and checked: the Khurja-Shikarpur road has been dilapidated for about 15 years; approval was given for about Rs 22.11 crore (article: Rs 22 crore 10 lakh 94 thousand) for about 35 villages, and construction is still to start after budget approval. Amar Ujala video (7 Jul 2026) confirms waterlogging on this road in front of the Shikarpur CHC and block office, which confirms the Shikarpur town stretch. The 2024 figure is dated. The article gives 13.650 km in the body (13 km in the lead). The Khurja end may lie in another AC, which is not confirmed.

notes: Identity verified: Wikipedia list row 69 is Shikarpur, Bulandshahr, reserved None; the AC article's extent is 'Shikarpur Tehsil; PC Katiyawali of Jahangirabad KC of Anupshahr Tehsil'. Under the namesake rule the town of Shikarpur (Nagar Palika) is inside the AC. Syana and Anupshahr places are excluded because they are not confirmed inside this AC. The current MLA is unconfirmed and no MLA name or party appears in any statement. Electoral figures are excluded. Searches for completed Shikarpur works in 2024-2026 found only planned or tendered works, so positives 2-5 are flagged as inference. One Statesman report of inaugurated Shikarpur-constituency projects could not be opened (HTTP 403) and is not cited. Field check: drain status at Balaji Market and the Kotwali turn; CHC prescription and pharmacy practice; the Mangraul and Chitsaun feeders; whether the Anupshahr-Shikarpur widening and the Khurja-Shikarpur renovation have started; whether Jakhaita is in Shikarpur tehsil; and completed Shikarpur projects from the local press. Round 3 voice pass. P2 weak positive: planned spending with no start date. P3 weak positive: planned pipelines, tenders complete, no start date. P5 weak positive: planned repair, not reported as done. P4 is an official claim, recast as hearsay.
